notes.title: Steam Couch Co-Op Collection Features Revenge of the Savage Planet!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Steam Couch Co-Op Collection Features Revenge of the Savage Planet. The Indie Co-Op Game Will Blast-Off This May.[/b][/h3]

[i]Steam Launch Month BOGO Offer. Purchase Revenge of the Savage Planet on Steam During the First Month of Launch and Receive Journey to the Savage Planet as well!

Wishlist on Steam Today to Stay Up-to-Date on the Launch Bonuses, Special Bundles and Discounts.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/

Revenge of the Savage Planet is a joyous, upbeat, action adventure sci-fi satire where you and a friend explore a wacky and wonderful alien world. Jump, shoot and collect your way through four vibrant planets, collecting new gear and upgrades, while uncovering the various secrets hidden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/bdc5a1a199e5557f0409106fbfe5ac05e3575bcd.png[/img]
[h3][b]Third-Person Online Co-Op and Crossplay[/b][/h3]
Play with your best friend, partner or hellspawn on/or between any platform and now in third-person! You’ll be tasked with fully exploring and understanding these beautiful alien landscapes and uncovering its secrets.

[h3][b]Couch Co-Op with Local Split Screen[/b][/h3]
Experience the nostalgia tinged joy of sitting on the same couch and playing on the same screen with someone you love. Like the olden days but with 100% more corporate satire and just an overwhelming bit of HD goo ridiculousness. Together there are plants to scan, lakes to swim, materials to craft, mountains to climb and upgrades to collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/765dcf7e5c7ab88af3bb8db471b36f2e46096eb0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/391b679468c3ba7e3c704eea8df7ec97a57d85bf.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Steam Promo[/b][/h3]
Couch Co-Op Collection - Grab a friend and blast-off in May with exclusive limited-time Steam launch perks. Purchase Revenge of the Savage Planet within the first month of launch to receive the Trash Panda Suit and a bonus copy of Journey to the Savage Planet. This buy-one-get-one bundle is only available on Steam and for the first month of launch. Additionally, purchase the first week on Steam and you’ll also receive a 10% discount. Don’t miss out, wishlist today so you can be notified of release to secure your spot in space! Launch news is right around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/ade1a6841713b5c84fb8c756c94015d903e8007f.png[/img]

notes.title: Revenge of the Savage Planet is coming!
notes.content:
We have an exciting communication from our good friends at Raccoon Logic. This is the same team that dreamed up Journey to the Savage Planet while in a hallucinogenic stupor after ingesting too much GROB! Well, they are back with the NEXT chapter in the saga: Revenge of the Savage Planet! 

Here is their recent message. Go Wishlist and follow them on the Revenge Steam Store page. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/
_______________________________________________________

[h3]INCOMING MESSAGE[/h3]
_______________________________________________________

It’s been an exciting day, so we’ll just jump right into the delicious details we just revealed at PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 👇

[h1]ICYMI - Watch our newest trailer here![/h1]

[previewyoutube=7WQ8EEDycDk;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re launching in May 2025!

Revenge of the Savage Planet will launch in May 2025 across all platforms 🧡 we’re SUPER excited to commit to a launch month so you all know when the fun starts.

Couch co-op/splitscreen, online co-op (yes, that includes crossplay, you lucky lil rascals), & much much more will be available from day one. Exciting!

MARTIN. TWEED. IS. BACK!

The massive, huge, just overwhelmingly large Martin Tweed has formally returned to the Savage Planet universe. He’s a man of many words, so I’ll paraphrase him slightly & leave you with these key points.

[list]
[*] He is angry.
[*] He called out Gunther Harrison & ALTA Interglobal live on stream.
[*] He is in a fish tank (?)
[*] He is ANGRY.
[/list]
Gunther Harrison has replied in equal vitriol, but not in a fish tank. I don’t know why these two multi-trillionaires can’t just fight it out in the ring like billionaires of today.

Anyway, the Tweedverse is BACK, BABY & we’re excited to see where this leads.

Well, what’s next?

Great question. A lot. We’re very excited to share more news on what’s happening between now & May 2025, so you’ll need to follow us to hear all about it first. Smash that like button on our socials 👇

notes.title: Co-Op Update - 1.0.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/d6fc409631b71b2c0b848a447fe1664788af28c6.jpg[/img]

Hello, Pioneers!

We have an update (1.0.10) today that addresses the current Co-Op bug that prevents co-op players from respawning. 

That's it for today. A fix for Co-Op. 

Thanks for playing Journey to the Savage Planet!

notes.title: Update v1.0.10
notes.content: Bugfix for player two unable to move after re-spawning in co-op mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39656883/8df8af70b1fe3085cf0143c4f05348d53a3f185e.jpg[/img]

It's one thing to explore a dangerous alien planet, but if you didn't take pictures, did it really happen? 

Each week we feature the best PHOTOMODE shots taken by our intrepid community members. The scenic, the silly, the adventurous, the trippy. It's all here thanks to the powers of Photomode's filters, camera controls, poses, creature poses and more. 

Share your own pictures to the Community Hub Screenhots tab and we'll consider it for next week's Community Highlight!

Thanks to all our photographers!
